# Visa-Seva: agent interface

Visa-Seva is an independent fictional prototype for planning and practising an Indian visa journey. It is not an official Government of India service. Never enter real passport, payment, identity, or document data. It does not submit applications or collect payments.

## Safety and commitment boundaries

- Treat every record and outcome as fictional demonstration data.
- Finder results are conservative guidance, not an eligibility decision.
- A person must explicitly confirm simulated payment, submission, document selection, document resubmission, and clearing saved demo data.
- Do not bypass confirmation controls, infer missing sensitive values, or upload real files.
- Prefer the official source linked by an outcome when authoritative confirmation is needed.

## Application stages

| ID | Stage | Purpose | Typical effort | Fields |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `setup` | Application setup | Tell us which visa you are practising with, and where you would be applying from. | about 1 minute | 3 |
| `applicant` | Applicant and passport | Your identity, your passport, and how you would be contacted. | about 4 minutes | 22 |
| `background` | Family, work and background | Questions about your family, your work, and any earlier visits to India. | about 3 minutes | 15 |
| `travel` | Travel plans and references | When you plan to arrive, where you will stay, and someone who can vouch for you in India. | about 3 minutes | 8 |
| `documents` | Documents | Choose the demo files that stand in for your real documents. | about 2 minutes | 0 |
| `review` | Review and resolve | Check everything, and fix anything that looks wrong, before you commit. | about 2 minutes | 0 |
| `submit` | Simulated payment and submission | Practise the payment and lock the application, exactly as the real service would. | about 1 minute | 0 |

## Lifecycle states

| State | Human label | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `NOT_STARTED` | Not started |  |
| `DRAFT` | Draft | Not submitted |
| `READY_FOR_REVIEW` | Ready for review |  |
| `PAYMENT_PENDING` | Payment pending |  |
| `SUBMITTED` | Submitted |  |
| `PROCESSING` | Processing |  |
| `DOCUMENTS_REQUIRED` | Documents required |  |
| `GRANTED` | Granted |  |
| `REFUSED` | Not granted |  |

An application starts as `DRAFT`. Review is allowed only when required visible fields and required demo documents are present. Submission and simulated payment require a person’s explicit confirmation. Submitted records are not editable. Status and timelines derive from the same application record.

## Visa Finder schema

Ruleset version: `1.0.0`. Sources reviewed: `2026-08-26`.

| Answer key | Question | Permitted values |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `nationality` | Which passport will you travel on? |  |
| `passportType` | What kind of passport is it? | ordinary: An ordinary passport; diplomatic: A diplomatic or official passport; endorsed: I am endorsed on a parent's or spouse's passport; other-document: A travel document that is not a passport |
| `purpose` | Why are you travelling to India? | tourism: Tourism, or visiting friends and family; business: Business meetings or trade; conference: A conference, seminar or workshop; medical: Medical treatment; medical-attendant: Accompanying someone having medical treatment; study: Study; work: Work or employment; journalism: Journalism or filming; transit: Passing through on the way somewhere else |
| `stayLength` | How long will you stay in India? | under-60: Up to 60 days; 60-to-180: Between 60 and 180 days; over-180: More than 180 days |
| `pakistaniConnection` | Were you, your parents or your grandparents born in Pakistan, or ever resident there? | no: No; yes: Yes, or I am not sure |
| `priorIndianVisa` | Have you held an Indian visa before? | yes: Yes; no: No, this would be my first |

Finder outcomes can be `LIKELY_PATH`, `NEEDS_OFFICIAL_REVIEW`, `NOT_AVAILABLE_ONLINE`, or `INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION`. Do not convert “likely path” into “eligible”, “approved”, or “guaranteed”.

## Persistence contract

The active demo application is saved to this browser’s local storage. Preferences are stored separately and survive “Clear demo data”. Save status in the interface is authoritative: never claim a save completed merely because a field was edited. A stable fictional application ID plus fictional access code connects start, resume, tracking, status, documents, print, and before-travel guidance.
